mapper.select: select * from prj_project_approval ppa where ppa.data_class = 'NORMAL'

SELECT t.APPROVAL_ID, t.PROJECT_ID, t.APPROVAL_NUMBER, t.APPROVAL_NOTE, t.FIST_MEET, ( SELECT meaning FROM sys_code_value_b_v WHERE CODE = 'SYS.MEET_TYPE' AND code_value = t.FIST_MEET ) FIST_MEET_N, OTHER, ( SELECT max( APPROVAL_DATE ) FROM prj_project_approval ppa WHERE ppa.project_id = t.project_id AND FIST_MEET = '1' ) FIRST_APPROVAL_DATE, APPROVAL_TERM, APPROVAL_DATE, APPROVAL_METHOD, ( SELECT meaning FROM sys_code_value_b_v WHERE CODE = 'SYS.APPROVAL_METHOD' AND code_value = t.APPROVAL_METHOD ) APPROVAL_METHOD_N, t.REPORT_COMPANY, '广东粤海融资租赁有限公司' COMPANY_NAME, ( SELECT company_full_name FROM FND_COMPANY WHERE company_id = t.REPORT_COMPANY ) REPORT_COMPANY_N, adjust, discuss, T.NUMBER_OF_JUDGES, T.approved_flag, (select s.MEANING from sys_code_value_b_v s where s.CODE_VALUE = T.approved_flag and s.code = 'SYS.YES_NO') approved_flag_N, T.approval_result FROM prj_project_approval t where t.project_id = to_char(#{projectId}) and t.data_class = 'NORMAL'
and nvl(t.approval_type,'NORMAL')=#{approvalType}

SELECT t.APPROVAL_ID, t.PROJECT_ID, T.NUMBER_OF_JUDGES, T.approved_flag, (select s.MEANING from sys_code_value_b_v s where s.CODE_VALUE = T.approved_flag and s.code = 'SYS.YES_NO') approved_flag_N, T.approval_result FROM prj_project_approval t where t.project_id = to_char(#{projectId}) and t.data_class = 'NORMAL'
and nvl(t.approval_type,'NORMAL')=#{approvalType}

SELECT t.APPROVAL_ID, t.PROJECT_ID, adjust FROM prj_project_approval t where t.project_id = to_char(#{projectId}) and t.data_class = 'NORMAL'
and nvl(t.approval_type,'NORMAL')=#{approvalType}

SELECT t.APPROVAL_ID, t.PROJECT_ID, discuss FROM prj_project_approval t where t.project_id = to_char(#{projectId}) and t.data_class = 'NORMAL'
and nvl(t.approval_type,'AUDIT')=#{approvalType}
